messages.subject: Energy Transition Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Strategic Partnerships
messages.body:
Dear Suzanne,

Green Future Search's focus on senior energy-transition and decarbonisation leadership aligns closely with my background across mining, sustainability and institutional engagement. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where transition strategy requires strong regulatory, community and government relationships. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, with broader international mobility.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
